data_source: synthetic demo dataset (ai-ml/app/training/dataset.py) - not real medical data

feature_descriptions.bmi: Body Mass Index computed from height and weight
feature_descriptions.sleep_hours: Average logged sleep hours per night
feature_descriptions.sleep_adequacy: 1 if average sleep meets the 7 h guideline, else 0
feature_descriptions.hydration_ratio: Average logged water intake divided by the personal water target
feature_descriptions.hydration_adequacy: 1 if hydration ratio is at least 0.9, else 0
feature_descriptions.exercise_minutes: Average logged exercise minutes per day
feature_descriptions.exercise_adequacy: 1 if average exercise meets the 30 min/day target, else 0
feature_descriptions.steps_ratio: Average logged steps divided by the 8000 step target
feature_descriptions.calorie_ratio: Average logged calorie intake divided by the personal calorie target
feature_descriptions.goal_code: Wellness goal encoded as an integer index
feature_descriptions.gender_code: Gender encoded as an integer index
